results.title: Spotless
results.overview: George, a heartbroken window cleaner reeling from a recent breakup, is drawn to the seemingly perfect lives of newlyweds Mark and Rosie. Hired to clean their windows, he becomes fixated on them, peering not just into their home, but into the cracks beneath their picture-perfect surface. His quiet obsession soon escalates into a dangerous attempt to expose the truth behind their façade.

results.title: Bare Skin
results.overview: Victims of extreme trauma are invited to a group therapy session to share their experiences in a safe setting, but as their stories are told, an unsettling truth reveals that they may all be connected in their misfortune.

results.title: Underpass
results.overview: A couple who meet at various underpasses to dance together as part of an affair, realise it has to stop.

results.title: Existential Risk
results.overview: Existential Risk is a film about the possibility of human extinction or civilizational collapse, as these questions (and others) are grappled with in Cambridge, England. A personal documentary in which the filmmaker's own existential crisis (micro) is contrasted with planetary risk (macro).

results.title: Instincts
results.overview: Maggie is in her final days of pregnancy, when she and her husband Sean are attacked in their isolated home by two people who decide to wait with them until Monday to empty the family's bank accounts.

results.title: King of the Apocalypse
results.overview: On the cusp of Trump’s second presidency and the likely pardons for January 6th rioters, Sky delves into America’s violent militia movement in King of the Apocalypse with unprecedented access to founder of the Oath Keepers, Stewart Rhodes.

results.title: Only Good Things
results.overview: Catalão, Brazil, 1984. The rural region of Batalha dos Neves is made up of large crop pastures, a few farms and divided in half by the São Marcos River. Antonio lives alone and isolated taking care of his small farm until the day he encounters Marcelo, a lonely motorcycler who suffers an accident crossing the region. Antonio takes care of Marcelo’s wounds. The two fall in love and live a story that transforms, destabilizes, and causes ruptures in each of them.

results.title: Oh My Godfrey!
results.overview: Godfrey Faircloughe Wilkins was just a normal peasant guy living a normal peasant life when all of a sudden he found himself transported from 1358 into the year 2025.

results.title: Places Called Home
results.overview: Eva (11) lives with her mother, Alexandra (35), homeless and unbound by rules. By day, they get by through petty theft; at night, they sleep peacefully in their car, living in a utopia of their own—until the limits of that world are put to the test.

results.title: Saa Vee
results.overview: A young man's life turns into a nightmare when his uncle's dead body disappears the moment he closes his eyes.

results.title: See The Sea
results.overview: A young boy who gradually loses sight goes on a getaway vacation with his divorced parents.

results.title: BFFs
results.overview: Two best friends play practical jokes on each other until things get out of hand.

results.title: Shake Down
results.overview: A recently-fired man tries to cheer himself up with a Butterfinger milkshake, but doesn't get exactly what he expected.

results.title: Surprise!
results.overview: 'Surprise!' is a horror-comedy about a working class mum  who comes home to the worst surprise birthday party ever, organised by her infuriating husband and judgemental neighbours.

results.title: La PremiEre
results.overview: Karol G is gifting fans with a new TV special called La Premiere, just in time for the holiday season. Produced by Bichota Films, this one-hour special offers audiences exclusive performances of songs from the album, new adaptations, unique versions, and multiple special appearances by artists and notable personalities. Filmed in multiple locations across Mexico City, Los Angeles, Cartagena, and Medellín, “La Premiere” is a visual and sonic celebration that elevates “Tropicoqueta” to a new dimension.

results.title: Chị Đẹp Concert
results.overview: Concert from the TV show "Chị Đẹp Đạp Gió".

results.title: Money Laundering
results.overview: While doing her laundry, an old lady discovers millions of dollars in cash in a turned on drying machine.

results.title: Skin of Youth
results.overview: Two young LGBTQ+ lovers in 1990s Saigon get entangled in the criminal underground and must do battle with dark forces that threaten their relationship and test the limits of their humanity.
